implementation_summary: Partition the reported integer RMSNorm inputMem-to-squareSumReg cone into registered parallel squares, registered balanced reduction levels, and a separate 64-bit accumulator update. The replacement anchor occurs once in the supplied Norm.scala snapshot. Valid and final-beat control follow the arithmetic pipeline, and finalization waits for the last accumulator commit. For the selected 16 lanes, statistics gain five cycles of pipeline latency; arithmetic II remains one cycle and the statistics FSM retains its existing two-cycle beat launch interval. The current nine-stage emission pipeline and its three-cycle unstalled launch interval remain unchanged. The supplied synthesis evidence already reports 155.81 MHz against the explicit 150 MHz target; this patch requires fresh compilation and timing evidence and does not establish a new pass.
